page.layout: One block of running text at top, full width; page number above it; below, a large empty area with a catchword-like heading "S 2 Liber" (signature and head) and rules. Digitiser watermark at bottom right is excluded.

main_text.p: ftiffimam hymno 90. statim ab initio præfert. cui adjicias licet 94. 102. & 106. qui sunt toti ferè χειλιαστικοί. nam de quinto eodémque novissimo quod censuit, de reliqs quibusque si paria statuisset, havdqaqam à rei veritate aberrasset. habent enim cum libri omnes latis tristia, & læta tristibus immista; tum & Hymni etiam ipsi iidem, qomodo vita mortalis, & Christiana cumprimis, eadem utraque freqenter sibi invicem intertexta.
main_text.head: Liber

page.notes: Page number "(132)" printed at top centre. The signature "S 2" and the word "Liber" at lower left are printed marks; "Liber" is set as a heading in large italic type. The first line reads "ftiffimam" (likely "fanctissimam" abbreviated in print; copied as printed). Greek word in the first line is printed as a Greek-letter word, transcribed as printed with [?] on uncertain letters: "χειλιαστικοί" [?]. The text "qomodo" and "freqenter" are as printed. Ornamental rules and scattered specks are not text.
